ev.q: The most common locations of ammonia theft events were commercial (88 [52%]) and agricultural areas (51 [31%]).
Most (48 [56%]) victims were treated at a hospital but not admitted
with Iowa (64 [39%]) and Missouri (57 [35%]) reporting the most events
Of the 1,791 meth events, at least 164 (9%) were known to have been caused by anhydrous ammonia theft
with Iowa (64 [39%]) and Missouri (57 [35%]) reporting the most events
The information in this report is based on events reported to HSEES from 16 state health departments
